review_notes: I read the whole file. It introduces no definitions, structures, classes or instances. It has only theorems: three private lemmas on `Ideal.IsHomogeneous`, which are existence statements about homogeneous elements and prime avoidance, plus the final `solution`. It uses Mathlib's `HomogeneousIdeal`, `HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant`, `GradedRing`, `Ideal.IsPrime` and `Finset` directly. It does not define a rival notion of any of these. The rubric covers competing versions of a concept, and it excludes standalone theorem duplication and proof shortening. Any overlap here with Mathlib prime-avoidance or homogeneous-ideal lemmas would be a theorem-level overlap, so it is out of scope. I did not search Mathlib for such overlaps. The `p2m_open` and `p2m_export` lines are project macros, and I did not inspect them. I am fairly confident there is no target for this rubric.
